summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py), added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. The only existing line removed is `from typing import Optional`, replaced with `from typing import Callable, Optional` because DataStatsd still uses Optional; this deviates from a literal reading of the spec. Tests, flake8, and black were not run because the instructions forbade running repository code; checks were done by reading the diff and confirming no added line exceeds 120 characters. Nothing is committed.
